MonthlyReport.title: MonthlyReport
MonthlyReport.description: Monthly fuel report uploaded by operational team containing aggregated and granular fuel consumption data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the monthly report, e.g. 2026_Juni

bulan.description: Month name in Indonesian, e.g. Januari, Juni

monthIndex.description: 0-based month index (0 for Jan, 11 for Dec)

uploadedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the report was saved

totalVolume.description: Total fuel volume issued in liters

totalHours.description: Total operating hours worked by all units

/monthly_reports/{reportId}.description: Collection of uploaded monthly fuel consumption datasets and yearly analytics summaries.

/active_dataset/{datasetId}.description: Active fuel dataset for dashboard processing and real-time synchronization.
